# Fixtures

`battle_full.txt` and `battle_short.txt` are real PTCGL "Copy to Clipboard"
battle log captures, sourced from the `sampleBattleReplays/` directory of
https://github.com/kagd/pokemon-tcg-battle-replay (game-log text, not that
repo's source code — it carries no LICENSE file, so nothing else from it is
reused here). Used as ground truth for `src/battle_log.rs`.
